$description: @moodforge schema:1.0 round:4 phase:brand-kit worker:moodforge-brand-architect theme:sorted version:v1 created_at:2026-08-30T00:00:00Z sha256:63eeb877831c3937dd79fb914afb2f90d5d2ffa83ab7139ae000cb7b80ffc670 artifact_role:tokens — Sorted design tokens in DTCG format. Consumable by Style Dictionary and Figma token plugins. Mirrors tokens.css and tokens.ts value-for-value.

bg.$description: The canvas. Warm cream is load-bearing — a cold blue-on-white SaaS base is an explicit anti-pattern for this product.

ink.$description: Text, borders, the one fill. 16.08:1 on bg.

rule.$description: 1px row dividers. 1.30:1 — decorative only, never a component boundary, never carries state.

ink-wash.$description: Nav row hover and active fill. Ink on it measures 14.40:1.

hero-field.$description: The login hero panel only. Ink on it measures 14.16:1.

dim.$description: 4.37:1 — FAILS AA at body size. Permitted ONLY on mono micro-labels: uppercase, >=0.13em tracking, <=11px. Never on a sentence.

dim-2.$description: 5.71:1 — passes AA at every size. REQUIRED for any secondary text a person actually reads.

focus.$description: System. 11.77:1 on bg but only 1.37:1 on ink — the ring is always drawn outward with outline-offset, never inset on an ink fill.

alert.$description: System. 6.90:1 on bg; cream on it is also 6.90:1. Never assignable to a chip.

bucket.$description: The four-bucket taxonomy. These are the four literal values of CategoryNode.bucket, fixed in the API type. Colour is for the closed set; unbounded user-defined category names carry in text. All 6 pairs separate on hue alone (tightest 65deg) and EVERY bucket is textSafe. Replaces the invented six-category set, which had no counterpart in the data model.

mono.$description: Every rupee figure without exception, tabular-nums, so amounts align down a column.

input.$description: Form fields. Never below 16px — iOS zooms the viewport.

figure-2.$description: Net Worth — the number you admire.

figure-1.$description: Guilt-Free Money — the number that changes behaviour. One per screen, never two.

spacing.$description: 2px base. 14 (row grid gap) and 22 (panel inner padding) are structural — treat them as fixed.

stroke.$description: Sorted has no shadows, so every edge is a stroke. These weights carry the entire sense of depth and hierarchy.

panel.$description: THE structural weight. Panels, fields, pills, chips, sidebar. If it is a boundary, it is 1.5.

tether.$description: The dotted connector. Deliberately 0.1 above panel so it reads as drawn, not built.

icon.$description: Glyphs authored on a 24-unit grid; renders at 1.42px inside a 30px chip.

radius.$description: Everything interactive is a pill; everything containing is 22. There is no sharp corner anywhere in Sorted.

shadow.$description: There are no shadows in Sorted. No blur, no spread, no elevation, no faked light. The stamp is the ONE exception and is permitted only on the primary pill CTA. It is not a lift — it is a stamp sitting on paper.

out.$description: Enter, press, reveal. GSAP equivalent: power4.out.

drawer.$description: Drawers and sheets. GSAP equivalent: power3.out.

hover.$description: Colour and background only. Survives prefers-reduced-motion.

stamp-press.$description: LOCKED. The translate distance MUST equal the shadow offset exactly, and both properties MUST share one duration and one curve. NEVER add scale(): the box-shadow repaint and the GPU-composited scale run on different pipelines, so a 1.5px hard border glitches on press instead of reading as one clean motion. Applies to every stamp component, not just the button.

contrast.$description: Measured with WCAG 2.1 relative luminance. Computed, not estimated. Regenerate if any colour changes.
